Class SearchHeroBean

java.lang.Object
io.goobi.viewer.managedbeans.SearchHeroBean
All Implemented Interfaces:

@Named @RequestScoped public class SearchHeroBean extends Object implements Serializable
Presentation data for the CMS search hero. Index facts are loaded at most once per request.

    • getHeading

      public String getHeading(String heading, String collectionsUrl)
      Links emphasized portions of trusted CMS heading markup to the collections. Existing links are preserved, including emphasis inside a link or containing a link; none are nested or overwritten.
      Parameters:
      heading - trusted CMS heading HTML, or null
      collectionsUrl - destination for emphasized text that is not already linked
      Returns:
      the heading fragment with collection links
